sn35.105:1.1: Kismiṃ nu kho bhikkhave sati kim upādāya uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhaṃ dukkhanti || ||
sn35.105:2.1: Bhagavaṃ mūlakā no bhante dhammā || || Cakkhusmiṃ
sn35.105:3.1: vo bhikkhave sati cakkhuṃ upādāya uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhaṃ dukkhaṃ || la || Manasmiṃ sati manam upādāya uppajjati ajjhattaṃ sukhaṃ dukkhaṃ || || Tam kim maññatha bhikkhave cakkhuṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || ||
sn35.105:5.1: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā ti || ||
sn35.105:7.1: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammam api nu tam anupādāya uppajjeyya ajjhattaṃ sukhaṃ dukkhanti || ||
sn35.105:15.1: Mano nicco vā anicco vā ti || ||
sn35.105:17.1: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā ti || ||
sn35.105:19.1: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammam api nu tam anupādāya uppajjeyya ajjhattaṃ sukhaṃ dukkhanti || ||
sn35.105:21.1: Evam passam bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmim pi nibbindati || la || manasmim pi nibbindati || || Nibbindaṃ virajjati || virāgā vimuccati || Vimuttasmiṃ vimuttam iti ñāṇam hoti || || Khīṇā jāti vusitam brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || || Dukkhassa
